children: today announced that the board of directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per share. The dividend is payable on November 11, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 4, 2026. The dividend represents a 9% increase from the previous regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.165 per share and is Brown & Brown’s 33rd consecutive annual dividend increase.
